Bundled chat-rendering libraries (unmodified distribution files):

- markdown-it 14.1.0 — MIT License — https://github.com/markdown-it/markdown-it
- KaTeX 0.16.21 (JS, CSS, WOFF2 fonts) — MIT License — https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX
- web-markdown.min.js: unified 11, remark-parse 11, remark-gfm 4, remark-math 6, remark-rehype 11, rehype-katex 7,
  rehype-stringify 10 and their dependencies (MIT, ISC, BSD-2-Clause), bundled by tools/web-markdown;
  every bundled package with its full license text is listed in web-markdown.LICENSES.txt
- highlight.js 11.10.0 (common languages build) — BSD 3-Clause License — https://github.com/highlightjs/highlight.js
- Mermaid 11.4.1 — MIT License — https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid

Embedded CPython (downloaded at build time by tools/python-android/prepare.py):
- CPython 3.14.8 Android release — Python Software Foundation License — https://www.python.org/
  Includes OpenSSL (Apache License 2.0), SQLite (public domain) and other components listed in the CPython LICENSE.
